findings.evidence: "Say it," he said. "You didn't see anyone."
findings.diagnosis: Demanding she verbally perform the denial is witness/consequence-management, not concealment — tips him toward the guilt reading and reads as coercion, narrowing the victim interpretation. The exact failure the brief flags.

findings.evidence: She wanted that understood, if only to herself: there was no kindness in it.
findings.diagnosis: The not-kindness is insisted on rather than only enacted — a mild protest-too-much.
